Ledger is a specialized broking and advisory firm exclusively focused on casualty insurance-linked securities (ILS) — a rapidly emerging asset class at the intersection of insurance and capital markets. We are the preeminent intermediary connecting insurers, reinsurers, and fronting carriers seeking access to new capital from institutional investors.

Casualty ILS is an attractive asset class for private credit / special situations funds, family offices, pension funds, and sovereign wealth funds looking to access an uncorrelated stream of cash flows based on a diversified pool of risk, exhibiting a risk-return profile similar to private credit and other asset-backed securities.
